git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Multi-cycle accretion (BA spec confirmed; not a single regression). Stage A criticals appeared due to validator INTENTIONAL_KEYWORDS not matching activity names. Stage B failures are surfaced by the very flip we wanted to land. Stage C is the user-saved Codex consensus path-B for image handling.
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: (a) timeline.json activity names lacked the intentional-keyword markers the validator looks for; (b) schemas had open shapes that quietly accepted bolt-on fields like accommodation_jade and per-traveler keys; (c) image_url was written into agent JSONs by 3 independent paths (save.py extract_image_urls + fetch-images-batch.py _update_agent_jsons + agent freelance writes) creating dual-write inconsistency.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: (a) renamed alternative activities to embed `[Optional ...]` keyword the validator already recognizes — no validator change; (b) flipped strict additionalProperties:false on outer envelope + day_entry + POI items, then opened only the documented freeform sub-objects with rationale; (c) PATH B: cache is sole source — agent JSONs no longer carry image_url; renderer uses _get_placeholder_image directly; save.py and fetch-images-batch.py write paths excised.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Diff > 20 lines is unavoidable for this scope: 31 schema flips × 10 files + 165 data field removals + 245-line _update_agent_jsons function removal + 5 helper functions in save.py + 3 renderer simplifications + 9 schema-additive fields. Each individual edit is the minimum possible for that target.
